name: Outbound Connection to Known Reverse Shell / C2 Port
description: Detects an active TCP connection to non-standard ports commonly configured for reverse shells (4444, 5555, 1337, 6667, 9001, 31337).
explanation: Default frameworks like Metasploit and netcat frequently use ports like 4444 and 1337 for command-and-control listeners.
investigation_steps: Identify the process name, path, and PID holding the socket.
Look up the destination IP reputation and geolocation.
Check command line arguments and recent process activity of the owning PID.
